heading: INT. TRAFFIC COURT - HEARING ROOM 4 - DAY

units.text: INT. TRAFFIC COURT - HEARING ROOM 4 - DAY
Fluorescent glare.
Beige carpet.
A flag leaning slightly.
A bailiff's chair, empty.
JUDGE PERPETUA OSEI-LANGSTROM (60s, robe over a cardigan, reading glasses on a chain) peers down at a file.
At the defendant's table, BARTHOLOMEW "BART" KENYATTA-VOSS (40s, wrinkled blazer, a cardboard tube under his arm) stands very straight.
Across the aisle, PROSECUTOR ILSE NAKAGAWA-OYELOWO (30s, immaculate, a binder as thick as a phone book) leafs through exhibits.
Your Honor, I'd like to submit the exhibit.
units.name: BART

units.text: What exhibit, Mr. Kenyatta-Voss?
units.name: JUDGE PERPETUA

units.text: Bart pulls the cardboard tube open.

Out slides a rolled-up poster, which unfurls across the table in a slow, majestic curl: a hand-drawn map of an intersection, annotated in four colors of marker, with arrows, sunbeams, and a smiling cartoon sedan.
Ilse gapes.
Judge Perpetua removes her glasses, polishes them, puts them back on.
Bart steps forward to flatten a corner, knocking Ilse's binder to the floor.
She kneels to gather it, he kneels to help, their heads nearly collide, and the poster slides off the table and onto Judge Perpetua's bench, where it covers her gavel.
Objection.
units.name: ILSE

units.text: On what grounds?
units.name: JUDGE PERPETUA

units.text: The sedan has a face.
units.name: ILSE

units.text: Overruled. Mr. Kenyatta-Voss, proceed.
units.name: JUDGE PERPETUA

units.text: Your Honor, as the map shows, the stop sign was obscured by a sycamore.
units.name: BART

units.text: It was obscured by a sycamore he planted.
units.name: ILSE

units.text: Prove it.
units.name: BART

units.text: I have the permit.
units.name: ILSE

units.text: She holds up a stapled paper.
Bart looks at it.
Looks at the poster.
Looks at the cartoon sedan, which smiles back.
I'll pay the fine.
units.name: BART

units.text: Forty dollars, payable at the window.
units.name: JUDGE PERPETUA

units.text: She raps the gavel through the poster.
It makes a small soft tearing sound.
